method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (5 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages/PDFs for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 5 Nov 2026: OECD Pillar Two hub and Tax Certainty Day 2026 event page (4 Nov) fetched. No new model rules, AG, GIR or Central Record release since the 30 Oct Inclusive Framework plenary item already catalogued. Bloomberg Tax 4 Nov report of Manal Corwin remarks on a taxpayer-initiated GloBE coordination mechanism is secondary speech coverage of work already noted in the plenary statement (§7); no standalone OECD document published. Prior in-window items unchanged (plenary 30 Oct; GIR XML Schema v2.0 ~20 Oct; Romania STTR 2 Oct).
coverage.HK: Checked 5 Nov 2026: IRD What's New fetched. Only in-window Pillar Two item remains 26 Oct Portal BIR82 filing / e-assessments. 2 Nov What's New / press covers LegCo CARF & Amended CRS Bill — not Pillar Two. No new HKMTT/IIR guidance or portal change.
coverage.SG: Checked 5 Nov 2026: IRAS MTT/DTT Third Edition e-Tax Guide PDF (published 30 Oct 2026) fetched and read; new item added (sg-2026-10-30-iras-etax-guide-mtt-dtt-third-edition). IRAS GloBE/DTT page and PwC Singapore Tax News (through 30 Oct) cross-checked. Bill passage (6 Oct) and QTI/SBTI list (13 Oct) already catalogued. No post-30 Oct IRAS/MOF Pillar Two release found; Bill still awaiting assent/Gazette.
coverage.JP: Checked 5 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched (through 2 Nov). In-window catalogued items unchanged (GIR AEOI partners 21 Oct; 趣旨説明 9 Oct). 2 Nov tobacco hand-held stock tax; 30 Oct CbCR EOI partner-list update and 法人税基本通達 opinion solicitation confirmed non-Pillar Two (CbCR ≠ GIR). No new JP IIR/QDMTT/GIR administrative guidance.
